acceptance_criteria.text: When given a single成交價 below 10,000,000, the Skill outputs service fee = 成交價 × 1%, then floors to the nearest 1,000.
When given a single成交價 exactly 10,000,000, the Skill uses the 1.5% tier and floors the result to the nearest 1,000.
When given a single成交價 between 10,000,000 and 29,999,999, the Skill uses the 1.5% tier and floors the result to the nearest 1,000.
When given a single成交價 exactly 30,000,000, the Skill uses the 2% tier and floors the result to the nearest 1,000.
When given a single成交價 above 30,000,000, the Skill uses the 2% tier and floors the result to the nearest 1,000.
The Skill does not apply progressive marginal rates; it applies only one tier to the full成交價.
The output is the final fee amount only, not a step-by-step calculation.
